description: Stand up a requirements box — one keyed web page where the user files what they want done, a scheduled task that wakes the agent to work through them, and a per-round report by mail. The service is a single dependency-free Node file: a JSON store, a keyed GET/POST/PATCH API, the page it serves, per-item scheduling, batch selection, and a do-it-now button that starts a session immediately. The patrol protocol is one markdown file, and the installer lays both down and registers the schedule.
description_zh: 立起一个需求箱：一页受口令保护的表单让用户提需求，一个定时任务按节奏叫 Agent 来做，每轮一封邮件汇报。服务是一个零依赖的 Node 文件（JSON 存储、带口令的 GET/POST/PATCH 接口、它自己那一页、按条目排期、批量勾选，以及一个立刻开会话开工的按钮），巡台协议是一份 Markdown，安装脚本把两者摆好并登记定时任务。
short_description: A keyed request page plus a scheduled patrol that works through it.
short_description_zh: 一页收需求的表单 + 定时巡台去做 + 每轮邮件汇报。
